_about: Art direction for blog-engine/tools/gen-hero-images.mjs. One entry per page that earns an original hero. Scores are a labelled heuristic: Search Console clicks for the last 3 months (2026-06-07 to 2026-09-06, hand-entered from the Pages report on 2026-09-08) plus intent, conversion proximity and how weak the current cover is. Every current cover is the same pixel-text card; Search Console showed the app icon as the thumbnail for about half of these pages, which means Google skipped the card.
style: Premium editorial illustration with a cinematic, softly rendered 3D feel. Setting: a deep navy, near-black galaxy backdrop with faint starfield depth, translucent smoked-glass surfaces and thin refractive light edges. Materials: matte black, charcoal, frosted glass. Colour is restrained: one cyan (#00E5FF) light source and one warm gold (#FFC940) accent at most, everything else desaturated navy and grey. Subtle volumetric glow, shallow depth of field, calm and confident mood. Composition for a 16:9 blog hero: main subject in the lower two-thirds, slightly right of centre; keep the upper-left third as quiet negative space; nothing important within 8% of any edge.
negative: Strictly no text, letters, numbers, captions, labels or typography anywhere in the image. No logos, brand marks, app icons, watermarks or signatures. No user interfaces, screens with content, dashboards, charts, chat bubbles, phones showing apps, or fake windows. No robots, androids, brains, circuit-board heads or glowing humanoids. No penguins or mascots. No recognisable real people or celebrity likeness; if a person appears, show them from behind or in silhouette. No neon rainbow palettes, no purple-pink gradients, no clutter.
